t: Fortress 5Ltr Natural Oak Decking Oil is a high-performance water-based treatment specifically formulated to protect and enhance timber decking. This quick-drying oil is touch-dry in one hour and recoatable within the same timeframe, enabling efficient project turnaround for trade professionals working on exterior wood surfaces. It offers robust water-repellent and breathable resistance, safeguarding decking against moisture and weathering. The natural oak tint subtly enriches the wood's appearance. Applicators will find this oil easy to apply with a brush or roller, providing up to 12m² coverage per litre for a lasting finish on outdoor decking.
